judgement.overall_note: Production correctly preserves all three at-risk carryover items and adds one well-grounded new decision (presentation deferral). However, it fails to record three of four gold-required new agreements (four-model benchmark set, Mimo's 32/36 score, and the backed-up-queries explanation) and leaves both gold-flagged prior items unmodified rather than enriching them with the concrete findings from the dialog. The state is internally consistent but materially incomplete relative to the gold standard.
